name: יַחְזְיָה
summary: Son of Tikvah, one of the few who stood against Ezra's way of putting away the foreign wives (Ezr 10:15). The name is the imperfect of חָזָה with יָה, “Yah sees”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Only Jonathan son of Asahel and יַחְזְיָה son of Tikvah stood against this.”

note: Takes h.bp.am (1 token). Whether the two “stood against” the measure or “stood over” it is read both ways.
